name: Neon
occurrence: Trace component of the atmosphere, extracted by fractional distillation of liquid air.
majorUses: Cryogenic refrigerant (cheaper than helium for some ranges)
notableCharacteristics: Its name comes from the Greek 'neos' meaning 'new' — it was found and identified within weeks of argon.
ncertRelevance: why noble gases have very low boiling points
whyHere: A completely filled 2s² 2p⁶ octet means no unpaired electrons and essentially zero appetite for bonding, which is exactly why it stays a monatomic gas down to nearly absolute zero.
didYouKnow: Neon signs don't actually all glow neon-orange — that colour is specific to neon gas itself; other 'neon' colours in shop signs are really different noble gases or fluorescent coatings.
genZNote: The OG glow-up gas. Every 'neon sign' that's actually a different color owes neon an apology.
